fixed: A Caller's Companion dance with more than one level checked, such as Easy and Intermediate, now comes in with a level of its own named "Easy/Intermediate", placed between Beginner and Intermediate in your list of levels, instead of with no level. A level you already have with that name is used, and undoing the import removes a level it added unless one of your dances uses it.

changed: The Caller's Companion mapper reads a multi-line Level into a combined name (ccLevelScale order) with a cc_new_level issue; ImportPipeline reuses a configured level of that name (ccLevelNameKey), and CallersCompanionUsrImporter creates or restores the rest, placed by ccLevelScaleKey, and records them on CcUsrImportResult for undo.
A cc_unmapped_level message no longer contains a line break.
